elevate.move: Make the stopwatch the only numbering system: retire the decorative 01/02 sequences and mono texture outside the clock and label each section by its clock position ('at 02:00', 'at 20:00', 'after 31:00'), so the cover-the-logo test rests on one device.

Turn the drawings into a sequence the visit plays: complete the six-station set with Hand-back, draw each one on as the dial hand passes its lap, and echo the lit station small in the hero strip, so the illustrations become the visit's record.
